groups.label: Adapter profile/readiness
groups.firstSafeOpportunity: Create a parity adapter-profile bridge so drawer helpers can call the contract module in a future block after endpoint/readiness fixtures prove equality.
groups.rollbackBoundary: Restore drawer-owned W262/W263 helper implementations and keep contract module as review-only mirror.

groups.label: Connected submit/refresh/import
groups.firstSafeOpportunity: Do not extract first; keep this path stable until review-only/admin packet helpers are isolated.
groups.rollbackBoundary: Any future edit must restore W264/W265 behavior and preserve fake-link blocking plus W151-valid import gating.

groups.label: Live evidence/signoff packets
groups.firstSafeOpportunity: First optimization slice: isolate review-only live evidence/signoff packet shape builders behind a parity wrapper while keeping normal consultant UI untouched.
groups.rollbackBoundary: Review-only packet generation can be restored to drawer-local helpers without affecting Build/Run or adapter submit.

groups.label: Story receipt/script/sequence surfaces
groups.firstSafeOpportunity: Defer until after review-only packets; these are visible consultant surfaces and need screenshot-style parity.
groups.rollbackBoundary: Restore drawer-owned story helpers and rerun W254-W258 plus W273.

groups.label: Lane-pack authoring/diff/review/QA
groups.firstSafeOpportunity: Possible second optimization slice: move admin/review-only render expectations before any lane resolution changes.
groups.rollbackBoundary: Restore drawer-owned proposal review helpers and keep source pack in src/contracts/lanePacks.js.

groups.label: Normal consultant UI renderers
groups.firstSafeOpportunity: Do not extract in the first runtime cleanup; visible UI needs a dedicated visual parity packet.
groups.rollbackBoundary: Restore exact renderer copy/layout and rerun W248/W258/W262 plus targeted visual smoke.

groups.label: Admin/debug-only renderers
groups.firstSafeOpportunity: Good early cleanup candidate after the live evidence/signoff packet wrapper because it is admin/review-only and hidden from normal consultant UI.
groups.rollbackBoundary: Restore admin renderer helpers and prove normal consultant UI remains hidden from diagnostics.

selectedFirstOptimizationSlice.label: Review-only live evidence/signoff bridge
selectedFirstOptimizationSlice.whyFirst: It is review-only/admin-only, has a focused W272 contract, does not alter normal consultant UI, and does not sit directly on the record creation submit path.
selectedFirstOptimizationSlice.targetHelperArea: W265-W268 live evidence/signoff packet helpers in idb-drawer.user.js
futureBlockScope: route review-only packet shape checks through contract helpers where straightforward
selectedFirstOptimizationSlice.rollbackBoundary: If any review-only packet field changes unexpectedly, restore drawer-local W265-W268 helpers and leave src/contracts/liveEvidencePackets.js as a mirror.

visualTestingDecision.reason: Review-only inventory and planning artifacts; no UI or runtime behavior changes.
